articles.title: Healey Dell tearooms win North West in Bloom gold for fifth year running
articles.excerpt: Healey Dell Heritage Centre and Tearooms has won North West in Bloom gold for a fifth year, and this year also took home a trophy.
articles.content_html:
Healey Dell Heritage Centre and Tearooms, tucked between Rochdale and Whitworth, has won a North West in Bloom Gold Award for the fifth year running.

This year the centre also came home with a trophy, presented by local councillors.

The glass trophy, from Britain in Bloom with the RHS, North West, is inscribed "For Best Small Tourist Attraction".

According to the centre, if it wins again next year it gets to keep the trophy.

In a post announcing the win, the centre said it was "immensely proud of what has been achieved here at Healey Dell".

It thanked its visitors, customers and friends for their support, and most of all its staff and volunteers.

"Their hard work and dedication are a huge part of why this wonderful little place continues to receive recognition," the centre said.

It added: "Five years of Gold and now a Trophy. Not bad for a tearoom tucked away in our beautiful little corner between Rochdale and Whitworth!"

The centre has invited people to visit for a cuppa and a bite to eat.

Source: Healey Dell Heritage Centre and Tearooms, supplied to Rochdale Daily. Photograph: Healey Dell Heritage Centre and Tearooms.
